definitions.pool_svc_*: NAICS 561790 'Other Services to Buildings and Dwellings' - includes swimming-pool cleaning & maintenance but also chimney, gutter, duct, power-washing, parking-lot cleaning. No pool-only code exists; treat as an upper-bound proxy.
definitions.pool_svc_estabs/emp/wkly_wage: QCEW 2025 private-sector annual average (mean of 4 quarters / 12 months); emp & wage null when any quarter is BLS-suppressed (disclosure 'N'); establishments are always published.
definitions.pool_svc_cbp_estabs/emp: CBP 2023 (March employment); fallback where QCEW is suppressed; CBP emp 0 = noise-suppressed.
definitions.pool_svc_nonemployers: Nonemployer Statistics 2024 NAICS 56179 sole proprietors/no-payroll firms (most solo pool cleaners); receipts in $1,000.
definitions.pool_svc_seasonality_q: Q1..Q4 employment index (mean=1.0) from QCEW monthly employment, averaged over the 2023-2025 years with all 4 quarters disclosed; src 'state' = state-level 561790 profile used when the county is suppressed.
definitions.landscaping_seasonality_q: same as above for NAICS 561730 (county, else state).
definitions.window_janitorial_*: NAICS 561720 Janitorial Services (includes window cleaning, residential & commercial).
definitions.specialty_trade_238990_estabs: NAICS 238990 All Other Specialty Trade Contractors - includes outdoor swimming-pool construction (mixed code); CBP 2023 because QCEW publishes no 238990 slice.
definitions.misc_retail_459999_estabs: NAICS 459999 All Other Miscellaneous Retailers - includes swimming-pool (above-ground) and supply stores (mixed code).
definitions.pool_wholesale_423910_estabs: NAICS 423910 Sporting & Recreational Goods wholesale - includes swimming pools & equipment (mixed code).
definitions.svc_per_10k_households: (QCEW 561790 establishments, CBP if missing) + NES 56179 nonemployers, per 10,000 households.
definitions.pool_svc_emp_per_10k_households: 561790 paid employment (QCEW, CBP if suppressed) per 10,000 households.
definitions.state_pool_share_recs2020: EIA RECS 2020 weighted share of occupied primary homes with a swimming pool (SWIMPOOL=1), state level; ACS and AHS have no county/tract pool variable.
definitions.pool_counts_note: No federal source publishes pool counts below state level. ACS has no pool item; AHS has no published county pool counts. Parcel-level pool flags (e.g. Maricopa assessor) are handled by another lane.
